entries.text: I just woke up after sleeping in late . I feel kind of tired since I went to bed later than I normally do . I don’t like staying up too late because then I sleep in late which makes my sleep schedule complicated . I also was tossing and turning during my sleep which made it less restful than I would like . Once I get outside , exercise , or drink some coffee . I think I will feel a lot better .

Currently I am feeling very excited because I am about to leave to go to a Halloween party . I am doing my hair and makeup to dress up as PERSON  from the movie Almost Famous . That’s a movie my dad and I really like so it means a lot to me that I am dressing up as her . It’s making me feel happy .

Right now I am happy because I am with friends for Halloween . Halloween is a nostalgic holiday for me so today made me pretty happy . I’m also really tired so I’m looking forward to going home soon . But overall I am feeling pretty happy and content .
